properties.label: 商城内城
properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 原始城垣几何约束的内城参考面 · 缺段推接
properties.enStatus: Inner-city reference constrained by original mapped walls; missing stretches connected
properties.note: 本轮撤销对2018总图内城线的整体配准，南墙、东墙、西墙及北墙已标绘地段直接采用原始OSM城垣顶点和边线；不再统一旋转成理想矩形。西北角、北墙转折及东北角按相邻已标绘墙段方向相交作参考连接，未标绘地段仅为参考面的推接，不能宣称已发掘城墙。原始开放墙线及墙体多边形原样保留；填充不是新增现存墙体或城门证据。
properties.enNote: The former global registration of the 2018 inner-city diagram is replaced by original OSM wall vertices along mapped southern, eastern, western and northern stretches. Missing northern corners connect adjacent mapped wall directions as reference only; they are not newly excavated walls. Original open wall lines and wall polygons remain unchanged. No idealized rectangular rotation is applied.

properties.label: 书院街府库基址群
properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 考古图近似配准参考 · 非原始测绘GIS
properties.enStatus: Registered archaeological image reference; not original survey GIS
properties.note: 按省考古院2025年专题文章的书院街北片区航拍标绘逐座描出17处着色夯土基址揭露部分，不包成一整块发掘场地。以道路旁场地边角和建筑旁基坑转折核对卫星影像作局部透视配准。各基址尚有未揭露部分，图中着色窗不等于全部原建筑外缘；未将2026年另一幅照片的编号强配到本图。其“府库”功能为考古研究解释，不能视为已确定宫殿。
properties.enNote: Seventeen separately coloured exposed foundation portions follow the institute’s Shuyuan north-area annotated aerial photo. Local projective registration uses identifiable site-edge bends against satellite context. These are exposed portions, not the complete original buildings or the excavation perimeter. Numbers from a different later photo are not assigned. The storage interpretation is archaeological, not a claim that these are palaces.

properties.label: 商城东城门
properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 考古确认城门所在缺口 · 现状道路地段定位
properties.enStatus: Archaeologically identified gate breach; modern-road vicinity location
properties.note: 省考古院2026年公布的2025年度成果进一步确认：今东大街穿过内城东墙形成的缺口为早商城门。点位取现状东大街道路双线中部与原始OSM城垣缺口的对应地段，不把现代路口中心当作发掘门道中心，不假造古门名、门楼或瓮城。
properties.enNote: The institute’s 2026 report identifies the present Dongdajie breach through the eastern wall as an early Shang gate. This vicinity marker is constrained by the two mapped road carriageways and wall gap, not a surveyed ancient doorway, invented gate name or reconstructed gatehouse.

properties.label: 宫殿遗址展示区
properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 现状遗址展示地段 · 非完整宫城边界
properties.enStatus: Present display grounds; not the complete ancient palace enclosure
properties.note: 按卫星可辨的东里路、顺河东街附近宫殿遗址公园现状绿地与展示地段标绘，依据市政府关于东北角约2.9万平方米展示公园的说明核对性质。仅为现状展示地段，原宫殿区大量遗迹压在周边建筑下；本面既不是完整宫城、也不是宫殿基址或宫墙的实测边界，不用现代园路形状推定古宫苑布局。
properties.enNote: Visible present green/display grounds near Donglilu and Shunhedongjie, checked against the municipal description of an approximately 29,000 m² presentation park. Much of the ancient palace district remains below surrounding buildings. This is neither the full palace enclosure nor surveyed foundations; modern paths are not ancient palace layouts.

properties.label: 书院街贵族墓地
properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 原始OSM遗址范围 · 非单墓实测界
properties.enStatus: Original OSM site outline; not a surveyed individual grave
properties.note: 保留OSM way 731825407的原始遗址范围，考古性质参照省考古院书院街贵族墓地成果：M2为高等级早商贵族墓。此几何是现代遗址标绘，不能当作全部墓地或单座墓坑实测边界；不因金覆面等高等级遗物直接认定墓主为商王，不新增皇陵或重复古都根点。
properties.enNote: Original OSM way 731825407 is retained as a mapped archaeological-site outline. Institute reports identify M2 as a high-status early Shang elite burial, not a securely identified Shang king. The modern outline is not the full cemetery or a surveyed individual grave; no royal-tomb or duplicate capital identity is created.

accuracyWarning: Manual photo-context registration and published diagram tracing only; fitting residuals do not measure archaeological positional accuracy. Exposed windows are not full building outlines.

notAdded.name: Complete palace circuit
notAdded.reason: Published sources confirm palace district, but reliable complete wall GIS/control plan not obtained; no arbitrary palace polygon.

notAdded.name: All eleven gate openings
notAdded.reason: Openings are not all securely identified early Shang gates. East Dongdajie breach has explicit recent evidence; others not invented.

notAdded.name: Closed outer city
notAdded.reason: Existing four reference courses preserved; unconfirmed north/east stretches not forcibly closed.

notAdded.name: 2025 northwest ritual courtyard / full 2025 numbered storage plan
notAdded.reason: Published photos not yet independently registered to reliable ground/site controls; not substituted with arbitrary points or enclosures.

properties.label: 商城内城
properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 考古图近似配准参考 · 非原始测绘GIS
properties.enStatus: Registered archaeological image reference; not original survey GIS
properties.note: 依2018年发表总图的内城墙线描绘闭合参考面，沿用既有外郭图的三处控制关系；南墙两端关联原始OSM城角。填充只表示内城参考范围，图面补接处不冒称现存连续墙体或城门实测。现存城垣原始几何全部保留在其上；北、西部的地下墙界仍需原始测图校核。
properties.enNote: A closed inner-city reference follows the published 2018 plan and its existing three-control registration, anchored to mapped southern corners. Fill denotes the reference enclosure, not continuously surviving walls or surveyed gates. Original mapped wall segments remain untouched; buried northern and western limits require original survey plans.

properties.label: 府库排水沟
properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 考古图近似配准参考 · 非原始测绘GIS
properties.enStatus: Registered archaeological image reference; not original survey GIS
properties.note: 按书院街北片区航拍图黄色沟线保留三段可辨部分，线段和端部保持开放。沟线配准参照与府库基址相同，不延伸穿过未发掘建筑。
properties.enNote: Three visible yellow-plotted channel portions follow the Shuyuan aerial plan, using the same registration as the foundations. Ends remain open; no extension through unexcavated buildings.

properties.label: 内城东南水网
properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 考古图近似配准参考 · 非原始测绘GIS
properties.enStatus: Registered archaeological image reference; not original survey GIS
properties.note: 依2026年公布的水系走向图转绘蓝色实线段，以同图长条发掘区四角对照卫星影像作局部配准；所示为发表图走向，不是精测沟岸。遗存涉及自然河道改造与人工沟渠，总长约540米。只表达图上可辨部分，建筑遮盖处另列虚线，不把现代道路当作古水道。
properties.enNote: Published solid-blue courses follow the 2026 waterworks plan, locally registered with excavation-edge corners against satellite imagery. They are diagram courses, not surveyed banks. The system includes a modified natural channel and artificial channels, about 540 m overall. Building-covered connections are separately qualified, not inferred from modern streets.

properties.sourceTitle: 郑州商城城垣、府库、城门与遗址定位依据
properties.status: 考古图近似配准参考 · 非原始测绘GIS
properties.enStatus: Registered archaeological image reference; not original survey GIS
properties.note: 仅转绘发表图蓝色虚线连接段，地下走向仍以原始考古测图为准，不当作卫星可见或全部连续揭露的沟渠；不在房屋屋面描成已发现沟岸。
properties.enNote: Only the published dashed-blue connections are transcribed. They are neither satellite-visible banks nor continuously exposed channels; original excavation survey data remains necessary.

innerWallAlignment.method: Mapped wall vertices used directly; missing corner connections derived from adjacent mapped wall directions. No change to original source geometry.

rootLocationReview.basis: Representative centroid inside the wall-constrained inner-city reference, replacing the southeast-corner marker; not a surveyed ancient palace centre.
rootLocationReview.identityPolicy: Raw catalog, siteKey/currentKey, names and visit identities remain unchanged; apply coordinates consistently when loading items and recordItems.
